concerns.text: Task T024a (Generate null model distribution) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depends on the data pipeline (T012-T017) and the model training (T020-T023) to exist. It cannot run in parallel with the training tasks as it requires the trained model's RMSE or the dataset to generate the null distribution for comparison. The [P] tag is incorrect; it must be sequential after T023.

Task T024 (Compare RF RMSE against null) is marked [P] but explicitly depends on T024a (Generate null model distribution). The text states 'Depends on T024a'. A task cannot be parallel-safe if it has a hard dependency on another task's output. The [P] tag must be removed.

Task T030a (Detect collinearity) is marked [P] but depends on T022 (Save model to data/models/random_forest_model.pkl). The task description explicitly states 'Load trained model'. It cannot run in parallel with T022. The [P] tag is incorrect.
Task T030b (Verify stability) is marked [P] but explicitly depends on T030a. The description states 'Depends on T030a'. It cannot be parallel-safe.
Task T031 (Sensitivity analysis) is marked [P] but explicitly depends on T022 and T030a. The description states 'Depends on T022, T030a'. It cannot be parallel-safe.

Tasks T010 and T011 (Tests for US1) are marked [P] but the description states they 'currently FAIL until T012-T017 are implemented'. While tests can be written in parallel, the execution of these specific integration/unit tests as described (verifying the pipeline output) is impossible before the implementation tasks (T012-T017) complete. If the [P] tag implies 'can be executed in parallel', it is false. If it implies 'can be written in parallel', the description should clarify 'Write tests' rather than 'Unit test for...'. Given the context of 'Status: Written, currently fails', the execution dependency is the blocker. The [P] tag is misleading for execution ordering.

The 'Independent Test' for User Story 1 states the pipeline can be run 'without training any model', but T017 (Validation) and T016 (Save processed data) are implementation tasks. The test tasks T010/T011 are listed as 'currently fails' until implementation. The ordering of 'Tests' before 'Implementation' in the visual layout is acceptable for TDD, but the [P] tag on the tests implies they can run in parallel with implementation, which is false. The [P] tag should be removed from T010/T011 if it implies execution.
